entities.summary: De'Anthony Melton, nicknamed "Mr. Do Something", is an American professional basketball player for the Golden State Warriors of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the USC Trojans of the Pac-12 Conference, but did not play in the 2017–18 season due to the events relating to the 2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball corruption scandal.
